verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents 'Creating custom rules' for transaction categorization, letting users define rules that automatically trigger categorization when transactions occur, and AI Close agents that automate reconciliation on close events — concrete evidence of rule-based automation tied to events. However, this is scoped narrowly to bookkeeping categorization/close workflows rather than a general-purpose rules engine spanning arbitrary triggers and actions. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader, user-configurable trigger-action framework beyond categorization/close (e.g., custom webhooks, conditional workflows across modules), and independent confirmation of rule behavior in practice.
